note: Read 2026-11-01 at the owner's word ("Build those first 3 starting with ledger first"; of the 21 countries read first: "It should cover across every country"; "Retry the blocked tax facts once all countries land"): the tax on a screen worker's pay in Somalia: a resident's income tax, social contributions, what is withheld at source, a non-resident artiste's withholding, an author's treatment, VAT and the tax year. Research and retry subagents (workbench/briefs/BRIEF-tax.md, BRIEF-tax-retry.md), every quote checked by the lead against its saved page.

figures.finding: Under the Income Tax Law 2025 a resident individual pays personal income tax of 0% to USD 1,200 a year, 6% to 6,000, 12% to 18,000 and 18% above (20% flat for a resident under 18); a resident is anyone present 183 days or more in a 12-month period, among other tests.

sources.said: PIT for resident individuals below the age of 18 years is 20% at a flat tax rate 4. The PIT rate of tax for resident shall be ▪ per annum USD 0-1,200: 0% ▪ per annum USD >1,200 - 6,000: 6% ▪ per annum USD >6,000 - 18,000: 12% ▪ per annum >USD 18,000: 18%

figures.finding: An employer collects tax from wages and sends it to the Inland Revenue Department, so an employee with one job and no other income files no return; payments for services bear 10% withholding at source.

sources.said: If you are an employee, your tax is collected from your wages by your employer on your behalf and sent to the Inland Revenue Department (IRD). … Service Fees (Adeeg) 10%

figures.finding: A non-resident individual pays personal income tax at a flat 18% on Somali-source income; service payments bear 10% withholding at source.

sources.said: PIT for non-resident individuals is 18% at a flat tax rate

figures.finding: Royalties and payments for intellectual property rights bear 15% withholding.
The year of assessment is the calendar year unless another is approved; the annual return and any balance are due by 31 March of the following year, with quarterly instalments during the year.
figures.applies: Taxpayers with business or investment income

sources.said: The year of assessment is by default the same as calendar year i.e. January- December. … you must always complete your annual Income Tax return and send it to the IRD within 3 months after the end of the Income Tax year i.e., by March 31st

sources.title: Somalia Income Tax Manual for the Income Tax Law 2025 and Income Tax Regulations 2025 (Ministry of Finance, Revenue Directorate, November 2025)
sources.said: PIT for resident individuals below the age of 18 years is 20% at a flat tax rate 4. The PIT rate of tax for resident shall be ▪ per annum USD 0-1,200: 0% ▪ per annum USD >1,200 - 6,000: 6% ▪ per annum USD >6,000 - 18,000: 12% ▪ per annum >USD 18,000: 18% … If you are an employee, your tax is collected from your wages by your employer on your behalf and sent to the Inland Revenue Department (IRD). … Service Fees (Adeeg) 10% … PIT for non-resident individuals is 18% at a flat tax rate … Royalty Fees (Xuquuqda Milkiyada) 15% … The year of assessment is by default the same as calendar year i.e. January- December. … you must always complete your annual Income Tax return and send it to the IRD within 3 months after the end of the Income Tax year i.e., by March 31st
